title: Low-light clarity & icon geometry pass for quickstart onboarding assets
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Audit and update quickstart onboarding visuals and screenshots for low-light and dark ambient contexts. Goal is to improve legibility of microcopy, harmonize icon silhouette geometry for smaller sizes, and produce a paired asset set (light / dim) for docs and in-product onboarding. Deliverables: updated icon tokens, screenshot shoot checklist, Figma component variants, and a short design rationale doc for engineering rollout.
acceptance_criteria: All primary onboarding screens have contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text and >= 3:1 for interactive iconography when used as actionable affordances
Icon set includes snapped geometry at 16/20/24px with simplified strokes to avoid visual noise in dim themes
Screenshot checklist created and applied to 12 representative flows; CI/QA screenshots added to design spec drive
Figma components exported with naming convention: onboarding/token/dim and onboarding/token/light
Engineering receives exported asset bundle, README, and mapping file for token names within 48 hours of sign-off
comments: 2025-02-18 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff — ran quick inventory of existing onboarding assets. Found 18 unique hero screenshots and 34 micro-illustrations. Major issues: microcopy contrast drops below 4.5:1 on several screens; icon strokes too thin at 16px in dim background. Setting up Figma file with new 'dim' variants and token layer.

2025-02-21 - Rohan Patel: PM review — agreed with scope; requested that we prioritize the first-time user flow and the API key setup screens for the first tranche. Also requested metrics: baseline screenshot readability test before changes.

2025-02-25 - Ava Martinez: Design critique notes — simplified icon geometry reduces visual noise for 16px by using 2px stroke equivalent and snapping shapes to pixel grid. Decided to maintain brand accent hues but increase luminance for low-light variant. Uploaded initial component set to Figma.

2025-02-28 - Maya Chen (Eng): Implementation feasibility — confirmed that token rename onboarding/token/dim will be backward-compatible if we add fallback mapping in theme loader. Raised potential issue with existing image compression pipeline stripping alpha on exported PNGs; recommended using 24-bit PNGs for screenshots.

2025-03-03 - Accessibility review (external): Claire O'Neal — ran automated contrast tools and spot-checked 12 flows. Passed body text targets; three CTAs still below 3:1 when icons overlay gradients. Suggested adding subtle halo or minimal fill under icons to meet ratio without changing brand color.
2025-03-05 - Ava Martinez: Updated assets uploaded and linked. Preparing handoff package to Eng (PR linked). Scheduling a short walkthrough with Devs and Docs on 2025-03-07.
decisions: Adopt two variant tokens per asset: /light and /dim (not 'dark') to better reflect ambient lighting scenarios and reduce ambiguity
Target contrast ratios: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for iconography used as affordances. Decorative icons may be exempt but flagged in spec.
Icon geometry strategy: prefer 2px-equivalent strokes snapped to pixel grid at export sizes, avoid inner hairlines and complex masks at 16px
Screenshots: capture hero flows with 4 brightness presets (100% / 80% / 60% / dim ambient simulated) and select the dim level that preserves CTA legibility
Do not change core brand accent hue; adjust luminance and surrounding surface to achieve contrast per token rather than new colors
next_steps: Ava: Finalize component variants and export package (due 2025-03-07).
Maya (Eng): Add theme token mapping and update image pipeline to preserve alpha (due 2025-03-09).
Rohan (PM): Coordinate Docs update to include new screenshot checklist and publish release notes (due 2025-03-10).
QA: Run visual regression on 12 representative flows using screenshotter and record baseline pass/fail (start 2025-03-07).
Accessibility: Schedule follow-up spot-check after engineering integration (target 2025-03-12).
